provenance.path: Chromium → temporary local HTTP relay → TLS-verified authenticated public Jupyter proxy route → hosted Decision Lab → GPU service. Assets and API requests use the public Jupyter route; the relay alone supplies the upstream authentication token.
provenance.browserTiming: Browser total and browser round-trip timings include the temporary relay and authenticated public proxy overhead.
provenance.adapterTiming: Provider latency and timing fields are measured by the hosted server adapter against the real GPU endpoint; they exclude browser-to-relay travel.
provenance.sourceHashMethod: SHA-256 of the scenarios.js bytes fetched through the same relay and public route immediately before and after the browser smoke.
provenance.testHarness: scripts/gpu-browser-test.cjs; no mocked responses, retries, discarded warmup, credential changes, or server restarts.

evidenceContext.sanitization: Removed private local relay URL and nonessential request IDs. Model decisions, latency, scoring, task outcomes, and original completion status remain unchanged.
evidenceContext.route: Local headless Chromium to local HTTP relay, then TLS-verified authenticated official Jupyter /proxy/8081/ route, hosted app, and live GPU.
evidenceContext.authentication: Notebook authentication stayed in the relay process and was not provided to the browser child. No credentials are published.
evidenceContext.browserTiming: Browser round-trip and task times include local relay and public proxy overhead; this is not a direct laptop-browser network measurement.
evidenceContext.adapterTiming: Provider latency is measured inside the hosted app around real GPU requests, excluding browser-to-app travel.
evidenceContext.sourceRevisionProvenance: Scenarios bytes fetched through this same route immediately before and after the run had identical hashes.
evidenceContext.accuracy: All four tasks completed. Image courier recovered from one detour: eleven of twelve moves were optimal and all five checkpoints were reached.
evidenceContext.limits: Thirty real calls, no retries or discarded warmup. Upstream caching was not controlled. This test did not repeat image support/procurement or establish production durability.
